name: Proper Ordered Sample Compression / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For finite concept classes.  This is the fixed-proper-reconstruction form of the restriction and teaching-plan proof underlying Theorem 4 of Darnstädt--Kiss--Simon--Zilles.
proof: Fix a proper order scheme and restrict it to any coordinate set.  Its restricted reconstruction remains in the projected class and its size does not increase.  The maximal teaching-plan argument then lower-bounds that size by the recursive teaching dimension of the projected class.  Maximizing over coordinate sets gives $\mathrm{pOSC}\geq\mathrm{RTD}^{p}$.
